ValidationRule.description: Checks Type and Student Intention to be entered.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordTypeId = '012d00000021xGK', ISPICKVAL( Type , "Continued Enrollment"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status,"Conferred with Student by Email"), ISPICKVAL(Status,"Conferred with Student by Phone"), ISPICKVAL(Status,"In Person Meeting")), ISBLANK( TEXT(Student_Intention__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter in a Student's Intention for this student.
